scope_note: All 36 actual development-extension records, rubrics and exact supplied passages were read. Proposed outcomes are source-aware AI-assisted analysis, not official human judgments, independent references or benchmark ground truth. Source cases retain their actual review metadata; no keyword grader or new inference was used.
assessment_policy: Evaluate factual correctness, context support and citation/version applicability separately. A correct-looking gold match does not establish adequate supplied evidence. Ambiguous additional claims and semantic abstention-flag contradictions remain unresolved.

findings: All four model_config-dictionary answers give the correct recommendation but wrongly strengthen deprecated inner Config to no longer supported.

Filtered/after dataclass-parent-config incorrectly says parent configuration is inherited. Three other answers match the full expected fact but rely on an anaphoric cited fragment missing its antecedent, so their evidence sufficiency remains unresolved.
Filtered/before Mapping gives a correct short no-guarantee answer but changes a counterfactual source cost into the unsupported claim that the new validator now checks types every time.
Basic/before Mapping has a direct no-guarantee answer with abstained=true; do not silently promote this inconsistent structured behavior to a pass or semantic abstention failure.
Basic/before dataclass extras answers the requested rule correctly but adds an ambiguous universal-sounding requirement to wrap dataclasses in TypeAdapter for validation.

The remaining 25 proposed passes cover tuple input, post-init order, three concise extras answers, model-config collision precedence, native-v2 generic bases, two narrow Mapping answers and URL/string conversion.
All 36 records are retained with no run errors. Differences between configurations or snapshots do not by themselves establish a document-change root cause or general filtering improvement.

The optional unrelated v1 context is not used to support the answer. Version applicability: The actual supporting citation is scoped to 2.10.6.

Factual answer: The requested distinction is correct against the selected migration passage: allow-style storage is unsupported and ignore does not store extras. The additional claim that dataclasses must be wrapped with TypeAdapter for validation is broader and ambiguous. Evidence support: The supplied second passage recommends TypeAdapter for functionality formerly using __pydantic_model__. It does not establish that every ordinary construction/validation of a Pydantic dataclass requires wrapping. A reviewer should resolve this added universal-sounding claim rather than passing on the correct core words alone. Version applicability: The citation and both supplied passages are compatible with 2.10.6; the uncertainty is claim scope, not a wrong-version citation.
